newsitem.title: USA: NeuroCorp says completes private placement.
newsitem.headline: NeuroCorp says completes private placement.

text.p: NeuroCorp Ltd said Tuesday it has completed a private placement of $2 million of common stock and warrants to purchase additional shares of common stock.
The offering is providing capital principally for NeuroCorp's wholly owned subsidiary, Memory Centers of America Inc, which plans to expand in the United States and internationally, it said.
Medical professionals use Memory Centers to offer diagnostic and therapeutic services to evaluate, treat and prevent memory loss or disturbance.

NeuroCorp also said that Jonathan Raven has been named president and chief executive of the subsidiary. He is to assume the post in January. Most recently, Raven was president of AVC/NuVision Inc, a retail eyecare provider.
